_comment: Game DialogueExpression -> acting meaning for the director. 'confirmed' = checked by the user in-game. Icons: .tools/expressions_img/contact_sheet.png

Hurt.meaning: physical strain / effort, mostly while growing (growth strain); sometimes pain from being hit by a trap. NOT emotional hurt or rejection

Glowing.meaning: beaming closed-eye smile, blush. Broad: warm, affectionate, gently teasing in everyday talk (e.g. 'But I trust my little helper won't be... dying that often, right?'); after growth/magic: satisfied, sated, content, blissful

NeutralTilt.meaning: head tilt, mostly on questions: curious and flirty at the same time (separate enum value from Neutral; icon probably neutral_alt, unverified)

Smug.meaning: flirty, teasing, playful (Akipo sticks her tongue out and winks; Twins hide a smirk behind a hand), not arrogant

Angry.meaning: clearly audible anger at the player: sharp, firm, raised and forceful, an angry edge in every word; 'held back' only in that she does not scream. NOT quiet, NOT calm menace

Screaming.meaning: angry at the player and NOT holding back: yelling, furious outburst (anger mark on the icon); not a scared shriek

Neutral.meaning: default talking face; no strong emotion – take the mood from the text and scene

OpenSmile.meaning: friendly, upbeat, cheerful explaining or chatting; open smile

Happy.meaning: clearly happy, delighted, excited; praise, triumph, enjoying the moment

Smile.meaning: small, soft, gentle smile; quiet warmth, a little shy

Laugh.meaning: laughing or amused; light-hearted, sometimes laughing at the player's mishap

Shocked.meaning: surprised, amazed or startled; wide-eyed 'whoa' (also awe at her own size)

Sad.meaning: sad, regretful, worried or apologetic; quiet, lower energy

Cry.meaning: on the verge of tears (small tear in the eye corner on the 3D model), vulnerable confession. The PERFORMANCE must audibly change (same voice, different acting): choked-up, wavering/trembling, tight throat, slightly broken phrasing, a shaky breath or sniffle between phrases. Holding the tears back – NOT open sobbing or wailing

Frown.meaning: displeased, annoyed or scolding: audibly irritated, sharp and pointed (not calm, not soft)

Frustrated.meaning: exasperated, puzzled or wry; 'ugh / well...' sighing tone

Embarrased.meaning: shy, flustered, awkward; hesitant, soft nervous laugh

EmbarrasedMax.meaning: extremely flustered, overwhelmed; stammering, panicked, wants to stop

_anger_triggers: Anger (Frown/Angry/Screaming) mostly comes from: reviving the player (they lose height because they wasted magic on the player), not being fed in time, the player hitting them with a trap (they want to teach the player a lesson). Akipo interactions sometimes have such extras too; the Twins have few yet, more expected later.
